description: Paid endpoint ($0.005): hourly funding settlements for one Hyperliquid perp (rate hourly/8h/annualized, premium) plus mean/min/max, positive/negative hours and cumulative rate. Give hours (1-720, default 168) or from/to (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 UTC, max 720 hours); interval=4h/8h/1d returns UTC buckets (mean rate, cumulative) and allows up to 2160 hours (90 days). Any Hyperliquid perp incl. HIP-3 (xyz:TSLA). History back to each perp's listing (BTC since 2023-05-12). Bad params or unknown symbol return an error and no charge. Returns the x402 payment requirements and URL. Free sample response: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/funding-history

hours.description: Last N hours (default 168; max 720 for interval=1h). Do not combine with from/to.

interval.description: 1h = raw hourly settlements (default, max 720 hours); 4h/8h/1d = UTC buckets (max 2160 hours = 90 days)

symbol.description: Hyperliquid perp ticker, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE; HIP-3 builder-dex perps as dex:TICKER, e.g. xyz:TSLA

to.description: End, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive) or ISO 8601 UTC; default now

name: get_funding_history
title: Funding history (paid, x402) — $0.005

x402.behavior: Tool returns x402 payment requirements + URL; caller pays over HTTP with own wallet. Charged only on HTTP 200.
